The static scanner hits are false positives resulting from misinterpreting standard webview DOM manipulation and internal messaging as malicious file system or network exfiltration activities. The code aligns perfectly with the advertised functionality of reading local EPUB files.

The 'token' here is likely a resource identifier or session token for internal state management, not a credential being sent to an external server.
